# Synthetic rejection examples for each editorial pattern.
# All changes and reviews described below are fictional.
# Non-comment, nonblank lines must match at least one baseline pattern.
# A line starting with "# " is a comment; Markdown heading cases use "##" or
# deeper and are asserted like any other line.

# Review noun followed by a discovery verb.
The review found a missing queue limit
An audit surfaced an empty configuration value
Fuzzing caught an invalid record length
Mutation testing flagged a missing retry condition
The reviewer revealed an unchecked result
Reviewers turned up a duplicate branch
Code review flagged an unused fallback

# Review actor followed by a progressive verb.
a reviewer checking the retry counter
A reviewer comparing the timeout values
a review pass inspecting the cache key
A reviewer bot suggesting an explicit return type
a reviewer asking about the default interval

# Discovery verb followed by a review noun.
A missing field was found during review
The duplicate entry was caught in the audit
A timeout mismatch surfaced during the review
The unchecked result was flagged by the reviewer

### Findings

## Review findings

Findings from code review
Findings from the review

findings refuted by the fixture

adversarially verified with a stub server
